title: IV era
note: IV era per docs/eras/iv.md ("Validator (-Tier iv)", "Gate to LuV" and the raise's decisions), in three substages: iv, home (Earth with the Moon base and the Mars outpost EV already reaches, and the End's pitchblende), and iv-venus and iv-mercury, reached together by the tier 3 rocket (synthetic inner-trip: the elite tank and motor, which need the antenna's inner planets chart, the thermal suit upgrade, fuel and oxygen). steam.json's eraSiblings makes the two siblings: nothing of Venus may need Mercury's iridium and osmium, nor Mercury Venus's naquadah, and nothing at home may need either. Every recipe of the Venus machines carries .dimension('gcyr:venus') and the Mercury ones .dimension('gcyr:mercury') (site checks); conditions.dimension.asKeysFor turns them, and the End's leach field, into the trips' keys (the End's key comes from synthetic end-trip, the End key item). Uranium comes from the End's pitchblende vein through the leach field alone (no drill takes it), tritium from the Moon's removal facility alone, naquadah from Venus alone, iridium and osmium from Mercury alone (decisions 2, 4 and 5). Our generator types are EU sources read from their own recipes (synthetic recipesOf): the reactor's cores, the Venus engine's ground heat, the Mercury field's sun and the RTG's pellet. The assembly line's research is modeled (conditions.research: the scanner's data stick carries research:<id>). IV-B6's mass production is modeled: the IV parallel hatch in our plants (requireAbilities), GCYM's alloy blast smelter at home, the assembly line with research after Mercury (its AE2 feeding is logistics, proven on IV-B6's bench). IV-B3 is modeled: the naquadah plant (Venus's oxide -> naquadah dust, IV's only naquadah: GT--'s neutron activator is LuV), the platinum plant's mode 3 (Mercury's iridosmine -> iridium and osmium), the Earth cut (no rarest metal mixture or iridium residue on Earth) and the parallel hatch in both plants.

A2.label: LuV-A2: the naquadah plant's mode 2 (circuits 2 and 3), the platinum plant's mode 4 and the LuV parallel hatch
A2.note: lib/packages.mjs: an older dump (before A2) lists these targets as pending (WARN) instead of failing them.

dimension.note: The bases outside the factory: the Moon (HV's moon-trip), Mars (EV's mars-trip), Venus and Mercury (IV's inner-trip) and the End (end-trip: the End key; the leach field's recipe and GTM's ender air carry .dimension('minecraft:the_end')). A recipe valid there needs that dim: key instead of being compared against the factory's dimension; GTM ORs a recipe's dimension conditions.

research.note: GTM 7.5.3's assembly line research (machines.enableResearch is on: the pack's gtceu.yaml keeps the default). A recipe with a research condition needs the research:<id> key, which the scanner recipe's data stick carries (normalize.mjs reads its assembly_line_research NBT); the line's data access hatch is a part of the machine.

pos_y.note: GTM's altitude condition (IV-B1's gas collector: Venus's carbon dioxide below Y 240, its clouds' sulfuric acid from Y 240 up) is read at the controller: a source with it is met on its planet by building at that height.

world.note: The first visit to Venus (docs/eras/iv.md, Route step 6): the trip's key brings back by hand 2 ores of each vein the pressurized drill's table offers (veins_venus.json: naquadah 7, plutonium 1) for the sample, and Venus's ground (GCYR's Venusian regolith is a falling surface block, the site casing). A one-off start: the pressurized drill keeps it coming.

The first visit to Mercury (Route step 7): 2 ores of each vein the Mercury drill's table offers (veins_mercury.json: iridosmine 3, graphite 2, sulfur 1) for the sample, and Mercury's ground (any macerator makes it Hermean regolith). A one-off start: the Mercury drill keeps it coming.

Decision 2 of the raise: the End's pitchblende vein (GTM's gtceu:pitchblende_vein_end, veins_leach.json) is mined by hand once, for the leach field's sample (raw pitchblende + raw uraninite); no drill takes it, and the in-situ leach field leaches its uraninite in place from then on.

Naquadah plant (IV-B3, iv/naquadah_plant.js, Earth): a 7x4x5 superacid hall of inert casing around PTFE pipe vessels and a radiation-proof activation chamber (laminated glass windows, a tungstensteel frame). Circuit 1 composes GT--'s live naquadah line: 4 naquadah oxide mixture + 15 antimony trioxide + 40,500 mB HF + the Pu-Be source (chanced) -> 2 naquadah dust, titanium and gallium at 50 %, hydrogen and water; 7,678 EU/t, so two EV hatches (IV voltage) before Mercury. GT--'s own neutron activator is LuV (neutron-activator-not-in-iv), so this is IV's only naquadah.
The naquadah plant built with an IV parallel hatch (IV-B3, lib/parallel_hatch.js; 4 copies want LuV voltage and a Pu-Be source each).

The naquadah plant on two IV hatches (wired or wireless, after Mercury): LuV voltage by GTM's two-hatch rule, so LuV-A2's mode 2 (circuits 2 and 3, 30,720 EU/t) runs and trinium sulfide becomes reachable before the LuV energy hatch. tiers/luv.json inherits it.
The platinum plant built with an IV parallel hatch (IV-B3; 4 copies run on IV voltage and want an electrode each).
The hot cell built with an IV parallel hatch in one of its part cells (IV-B6, lib/parallel_hatch.js): up to 4 copies of a run. The hatch takes the IV sensor and emitter: Mercury.
The fuel fabrication plant built with an IV parallel hatch (IV-B6).
The heavy-water plant built with an IV parallel hatch (IV-B6, proven: 4 copies of the exchange, the H2S charge still 1,000 mB).

Fission reactor (IV-A2, iv/fission_reactor.js, Earth): a generator of its own type, up to 4 channels; the programmed circuit picks the core (1 LEU in light water, 2 LEU in heavy water, 3 MOX in heavy water, 4 breeder); the assembly is a chanced input and the spent assembly a chanced output, the heavy water comes out tritiated; 1-4 dynamo hatches of any tier (one 16 A IV hatch carries 131,072 EU/t). The EU is the synthetic fission, read from its cores.

Hot cell (IV-A3, iv/hot_cell.js, Earth): radiation-proof casing cells behind lead glass; circuit 1 enrichment (composed from GTM's live UF6 line: 30 uraninite + 40,000 mB HF -> U-235, U-238 and the fluorine back as F2), 2 MOX, breeder, RTG pellet and Pu-Be source, 3 reprocessing, 4 radon (no plutonium stock). All at 7,670-7,680 EU/t.

In-situ leach field (IV-A4, iv/uranium_cycle.js, the End): a five-spot of wells and an inert header house. One recipe per leach vein (veins_leach.json): the pitchblende sample (never used up) + the ion-exchange resin (1 %) + sulfuric acid + oxygen -> 2 uraninite + radioactive waste (1 %), 6,800 EU/t, .dimension('minecraft:the_end'). The pack's uranium.

Fuel fabrication plant (IV-A4, Earth): circuit 1 LEU pellets (U-235 + U-238 + oxygen, 500 mB hydrogen kept: a chance-0 fluid, capital), 2 Zircaloy cladding tubes, 3 the LEU assembly (pellets, tubes, Moon helium). Its sintering tunnel takes Kanthal or hotter coils.

Heavy-water plant (IV-A5, iv/heavy_water_plant.js, Earth): circuit 1 exchange (Martian ice + steam, with a 1,000 mB H2S charge that is never used up: chance 0, capital), circuit 2 finishing (concentrate -> heavy water). 1,907 and 477 EU/t: an EV hatch runs both; the controller is IV.

Fluorspar kiln (IV-A6, iv/fluorspar_kiln.js, Earth): 3 fluorite dust + 1,000 mB sulfuric acid + 2,000 mB water -> 2,000 mB HF + 8 gypsum dust, 30 EU/t a charge, up to 256 charges at once (one IV hatch at full feed). The only route from fluorite to fluorine.

Tritium removal facility (IV-B4, iv/tritium_removal.js, the Moon): one recipe, 1,000 mB tritiated heavy water + a 100 mB deuterium charge (chance 0) -> 900 mB heavy water + 200 mB tritium, 6,880 EU/t (half at night, a run-start modifier the validator doesn't see), .dimension('gcyr:luna'). The pack's only tritium.

Pressurized vein drill (IV-B1, iv/venus.js, Venus and Mars): a regolith pad, an inert pressure housing, a filter casing deck and a tungstensteel pipe string; it runs only vein_drilling/iv/pressurized_* (its veto; the Mercury drill's prefix is refused), the IV bit at 0.25 %, cap 128. On Venus 200 mB of distilled water a run leaves as steam (the heat tax); on Mars it drills dry.

Venus heat engine (IV-B1, Venus): a generator of its own type, 200 mB of distilled water a 20 s cycle -> 8,192 EU/t and 32,000 mB of steam, .dimension('gcyr:venus'), always on (Venus is fixed at noon). 1-2 dynamo hatches (one IV or two EV). The EU is the synthetic venus-heat.

Venus acid works (IV-B1, Venus): the clouds' sulfuric acid + the platinum gauze (0.1 %) -> distilled water + oxygen; circuit 1 vents the SO2, circuit 2 keeps it (refuses voiding). 7,500 EU/t, .dimension('gcyr:venus').

Mercury vein drill (IV-B2, iv/mercury.js, Mercury): a heat-shield brick body under a sunshade; it runs only vein_drilling/iv/mercury_* (its veto), by day with 10 mB of liquid nitrogen a bore, at night dry (a run-start modifier the validator doesn't see: either recipe counts), the IV bit, cap 128.

Mercury solar works (IV-B2, Mercury): 8 heliostat mirrors, a focal furnace and an evaporation bell on Mercury rock. Heat-shield bricks (Hermean regolith), thin-film panels and the iridosmine fusion (-> rarest metal mixture + OsO4: Mercury's route into GT--'s iridium and osmium chain); .dimension('gcyr:mercury'), a quarter of the EU/t when a run starts in the sun.

Mercury solar field (IV-B2, Mercury): the lunar plan with 36 Hermean thin-film panels; a generator of its own type, 2,010 EU/t a lit panel by day (72,360 EU/t full), .dimension('gcyr:mercury'). The EU is the synthetic mercury-solar.

Interferometer (IV-B2, observatory step 5, Mercury): three dishes and a correlator hut. At night on Mercury, the Moon's Lunar VLBI Recording + the Inner Planets Chart (kept) -> the Outer System Chart (the next trip), and with that chart kept -> the Sagittarius A* Signal. 7,680 EU/t, .dimension('gcyr:mercury').

synthetic.note: GTM's IV -> LuV transformer on the IV grid: the gate's 131,072 EU/t, one full reactor or reactor and extreme combustion engines (amperage isn't modeled).
The End (MV's key): IV's leach field works there (its recipe carries .dimension('minecraft:the_end')), as do GTM's ender air collectors (offworld_only.json strips its radon, deuterium and tritium).

The trip to Venus and Mercury (docs/eras/iv.md, Route step 5; IV-B5): a tier 3 rocket (GCYR floors the average of the motor and tank tiers, so every motor and tank is elite: both remade in the IV assembler with tungsten steel and the inner planets chart; two elite tanks for the trip's 14 B of fuel), the suit with a heat shielding fabric smithed into every piece (the thermal upgrade template: PBI, Kapton K, titanium), fuel and oxygen. It gives both keys: Venus and Mercury are reached together. Proxima b is at rocket tier 4: no key. Capital: the return is by waystone.

The fission reactor's EU (IV-A2), one rule per core read from its recipes: LEU (light or heavy water), MOX or breeder assemblies, water and heavy water. 16,384-32,768 EU/t a channel, 131,072 EU/t with four heavy-water channels: IV power that burns nothing.
The Venus heat engine's EU (IV-B1): distilled water, on Venus only (its recipe's dimension needs the dim:gcyr:venus key). 8,192 EU/t, always on.
The Mercury solar field's EU (IV-B2): a programmed circuit, on Mercury by day (dim:gcyr:mercury). 72,360 EU/t full.
The RTG cell's EU (IV-B5): an RTG pellet now and then, anywhere, day and night. 2,048 EU/t (one EV amp): it starts every base.
